Plot Generic Anomaly with Standardized Scorecard With Composite Computed Internally-Blank Scorecard With Colour Legend for Ecoystem Summary

plot_anomaly_comp_B.Rd

Creates a publication-quality anomaly plot with stacked bars and a scorecard. The function automatically calculates a composite annual sum and a standardized scorecard value. Standardized scores (Z-scores) can be calculated relative to a specific baseline year range (e.g., a climate normal) or the entire time series. The scorecard is left blank and a scale bar for the anomaly is added to match the aesthetic of the RV anomaly plots.

Usage

plot_anomaly_comp_B(
  data,
  value_col,
  var_col = NULL,
  unit = NULL,
  show_composite = TRUE,
  show_scorecard = TRUE,
  year_range = NULL,
  baseline_range = NULL,
  x_breaks_interval = 3,
  colors = NULL,
  lang = "en",
  y_label = NULL,
  y_breaks = ggplot2::waiver(),
  base_size = 14
)

Arguments

data

Data frame containing year and the anomaly values.

value_col

Unquoted name of the anomaly column for the bars.

var_col

Optional unquoted name of the grouping column for stacked bars.

unit

Optional string for units (e.g., "m"). Appends to legend items only.

show_composite

Logical. Should the composite line be drawn?

show_scorecard

Logical. Should the heatmap scorecard be drawn?

year_range

Numeric vector c(start, end) for plot display limits.

baseline_range

Numeric vector c(start, end) for Z-score baseline. If NULL, defaults to the entire time series in the data.

x_breaks_interval

Numeric. Interval for year labels. Defaults to 3.

colors

Optional character vector of colors. Defaults to "YlGnBu".

lang

Language: "en" (default) or "fr".

y_label

Optional string for the y-axis title. Defaults to "Anomalies".

y_breaks

Optional numeric vector for y-axis tick marks.

base_size

Numeric. Base font size. Defaults to 14.

Value

A combined ggplot/cowplot object.
